name: Baltic Reefer Management
script: Thank Lena for the Polar Bay requisition; confirm Alexandria delivery on arrival ≈ 26 Nov; ask for the IMO and a quote deadline. Mention our cold-chain trucks for provisions and the 24/7 Suez transit desk.

name: Gulf Star Shipping
script: We submitted our vendor registration on 2 Nov. Is anything missing on your side, and when will the committee decide? Mention: 24/7 Suez Canal transit supply and on-board delivery at anchorage.

name: Medline Tankers
script: Follow up the Posidonia meeting: send the approved “Intro — ship managers” email with our Suez/Alexandria coverage, then ask which documents their vendor registration needs.

name: Aegean Ferries
nextStep: Intro call with the fleet superintendent
script: Introduce Golden Sea: cabin and provision stores for their Alexandria calls, one quotation within 24 h, Arabic/English documents. Ask who approves new suppliers and when their next Alexandria call is.

name: Red Sea Dredging
nextStep: Send capability deck and first price list
script: We're now on your approved vendor list — attached our capability deck and price list for engine stores, PPE and welding. Could we visit the Suez base next week to see the store room?

name: Nordvik Ship Management
nextStep: Quarterly review call with Ingrid L.
script: Review the quarter: 9 RFQs, quote turnaround down to 1.6 days. Ask about MV Fjord Spirit and the rest of the fleet we don't supply yet, and whether a fleet price agreement for engine stores would help.
